Players skip Blender *_LOD1 duplicates. 2026-10-07: +4 interactive CKA sims (NetworkPolicy, RBAC, scheduling, HPA) over the existing Blender-polished glTF; predict options shuffled per attempt. 2026-10-08: +6 interactive drills (storage PV/PVC, Ingress, ConfigMap/Secret propagation, CNI, service-mesh mTLS, control-plane failures) — every CKA spatial scene is now stateful; keyed answers spread across option positions.

scenes.note: Reuses the lecture control-plane glTF; no new asset.

cka_coverage.muskVerdict: Closer/NO until live UE host + hosted fleet exist

sims.player: /assets/il-immersive-3d.js (v1.10.0, data-il-sim; options shuffled per attempt; WebXR entry + in-headset world-space predict HUD; in-scene CLI lab + Lab Muse task coach; drills mount without a 3D render under reduced motion / no WebGL)
sims.honesty: Rules engine over authored glTF. No live cluster, AWS account, or hosted fleet.

exam.pool: CKA predict checkpoints only (excludes AWS + Istio mesh)
exam.honesty: Timed mock over in-browser 3D sims. Not a live cluster, not killer.sh, not the CNCF CKA.

review.scheduler: Leitner boxes 0-6 (0, 10m, 1d, 3d, 7d, 16d, 35d); miss -> box 0; correct slower than 45s holds box; correct first sighting on exam -> box 2
feeds: exam papers (/immersive/exam/, incl. timeouts as misses)
review.mastery: avg box / 6 over every CKA checkpoint in domain; unseen = 0
review.honesty: On-device spaced repetition over the in-browser 3D rules engine. Not FSRS, not a trained model, no server or cohort data, not a live cluster.

webxr.entry: Enter VR / Enter AR on every ScenePlayer stage (free-play, /immersive/exam/, /immersive/review/) — shown only when navigator.xr.isSessionSupported() is true; hidden without WebXR and under prefers-reduced-motion
webxr.render: Same WebGL context made XR-compatible → XRWebGLLayer; per-XRView stereo draw of the same authored .glb; page orbit RAF paused, restored on session end
webxr.input: select prefers in-headset predict HUD (ray-hit or cursor commit); else flips the next free-play sim toggle (no toggle flips on graded exam/review); squeeze or Exit ends the session
webxr.honesty: WebXR over the authored glTF, rendered locally in this browser — not Unreal Pixel Streaming, not a hosted cluster. In-headset predict HUD is local WebGL UI (not Unreal UMG / Pixel Streaming HUD). Verified in CI against a scripted navigator.xr fake (headless Chromium has no XR device), not a physical headset.

hud.surface: World-space WebGL quads (canvas textures) for predict prompt + shuffled options + reveal; shown only while an XR session is active
hud.input: Controller select / ray-hit chooses an option in-headset; no-ray fallback commits the highlighted cursor option. Free-play also offers a Next drill chip so the loop can start without the page. Graded exam/review: select clicks the matching page option button when present (same commit path).
hud.honesty: Local WebGL/WebXR UI over authored glTF — not Unreal UMG, not a Pixel Streaming HUD, not a hosted cluster.

cli.player: il-immersive-3d.js v1.10.0 (free-play stages only; not on graded /immersive/exam/ or /immersive/review/)
cli.verify: Killercoda-style tasks: goal → ordered steps (event steps must follow the previous event step; state steps are checked live) → complete
ux: check (and a Check button) · hint · solution · task · reset · clear · help
analytics: immersive_cli_cmd (verb + exit code only, never the raw command text)
immersive_cli_coach (action + level + step index only, never command text)
cli.storage: localStorage il.immersiveCli.v1 (task completions + best command count, device only)
cli.honesty: Simulated shell over the in-browser rules engine — real CLI syntax, computed output (kubectl/etcdctl/aws-shaped, not byte-identical). Not a real shell, container, cluster, AWS account or hosted lab fleet. Unmodelled commands say so instead of inventing output.

coach.benchmark: Killercoda Brain (2026): hint vs solution mode, hint offered after the 2nd failed verification, explains why a solution is not accepted
coach.ladder: check #1 on a step → diagnosis · check #2+ → diagnosis + tip (never the command) · solution → exact command
diagnosis: out of order (seen before the previous step verified)
right command family, wrong cluster state
coach.spatial: each step names authored glTF nodes (focus regex, unit-tested against the .glb); the player pulses them gold for ~9 s — also in WebXR; static stages list them
coach.voice: optional 'Lab Muse voice' toggle — browser speechSynthesis only (no cloud TTS, no key); hidden when unavailable
coach.honesty: Deterministic rules over the same in-browser sim state — not an LLM, not reading a real terminal, knows only what the drill models.
